name: Funding crowding filter on buy-and-hold (BTC, ETH daily)

history.reason: Pre-registered test (BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT 1d, 2020-01..2025-10, crowded_pct 30; runs 20261113-073754-e1a047 and 20261113-073756-eb5043). BTC passed all four rules, but only just: Sharpe 1.070 vs 1.067 for holding, drawdown -75.3% vs -76.6%, +1,223% vs +1,165% for BTC at the same 89% exposure (holding made +1,420%). ETH failed rules 1-3: Sharpe 0.87 vs 1.12, drawdown -79.3% vs -79.3% (marginally worse), +760% against +2,286% for ETH at the same 87% exposure. Stepping aside on high funding missed more of ETH's rallies than it avoided falls. Another threshold, or BTC alone, would be chosen from these results: a new note and new trials if ever tested.
